messages:
elaine: Quick kudos ping — huge thanks to @omar and @jin for rescuing the pantry fridge before the Monday all-hands. Saved the perishables and the snack table 🙌

omar: was a team sprint. jin found the rogue temp sensor, i taped the loose wire. shoutout to @tara for running the logistics and keeping snacks labeled.

jin: also shoutout to @solo for bringing spare batteries and a calm demeanor. tiny victory for office morale.

people-ops-bot: Poll: 'Send a small thank-you treat to the pantry crew?' React: :white_check_mark: Yes / :gift: Vouchers / :coffee: Coffee delivery

tara: :white_check_mark: from me — and thanks to @elaine for flagging the fridge early.

frank: +1. also adding a tiny kudos line in the weekly micro-newsletter. elaine, can you paste 1-line kudos for inclusion?

elaine: "Pantry heroes: Omar (fix), Jin (sensor sleuth), Tara (logistics), Solo (supplies) — thanks for keeping our demos snack-ready!" :tada:

devops-bot: Logged maintenance action: fridge-tilt-corrected @ 08:42 — ticket #4521 archived.

people-ops-bot: Noted. Scheduling a small snack box and voucher batch for remote folks. If you prefer anonymity, DM @people-ops.

jin: love this. tiny gif to celebrate? :partyparrot:

elaine: Perfect. Closing thread — gratitude parade incoming. :sparkles:
